newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP to shut stainless steel plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP to shut stainless steel plant.

text.p: The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would close its stainless steel plant in Port Kembla, New South Wales, in May 1997.
BHP said the action was being taken after a lengthy review over some years and after consideration of a number of options, including the possible sale or joint venture of the business.
The plant's 260 employees would be offered other positions within the company, BHP said.

BHP said it ceased production of stainless steel over a decade ago and since that time has been an importer of semi-processed stainless steel coils, which were further processed and then supplied to Australian customers.
